headline: COL @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is COL 4.32 at ARI 6.00, with a projected total of 10.32. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: COL moved +0.08 runs while ARI moved +0.79, changing the projected margin by -0.71 runs. The projected total climbed +0.87, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -14.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Zach Agnos has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Corbin Carroll, Ketel Marte, Ildemaro Vargas, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Edouard Julien, Adrian Del Castillo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
